rachel (People Ops): @here Quick heads-up for Boston team: the city notified us of a planned water-main pressure test on Fri 2026-09-03 08:00-14:00. Building will have low water pressure and intermittent hot-water outages during the window.

rachel (People Ops): Important notes: please avoid scheduling any events that need hot water (eg. catering with on-site steamers) between 09:00-13:00. If you have lab gear or water-cooled equipment, reply now so Facilities can arrange protections.

ben (Facilities): Short version: toilets and sinks will work but pressure may be low; showers and kitchen hot taps may be off for short periods. Well post signage at all entrances.

maya: We were planning the annual summer volunteer meetup + potluck that morning. Any workaround?

rachel (People Ops): @maya We recommend moving the potluck to the afternoon block 14:30-16:30 (same day) or using the neighboring community center (we booked the hall 09:00-13:00 just in case). Which do you prefer?

maya: Afternoon works better for volunteers, can we still get the vendor to deliver around 14:00?

food-vendor-bot: Vendor update: CaterCo can shift delivery to 14:00-14:30 for the potluck and will use insulated carriers. Confirm by EOD Wed to avoid fees.

ben (Facilities): If you pick community center, we'll provide a small stipend for transit and cover access. Also we can give you two folding tables and a cart for gear.

tom: I need to access the lab fridge at 10:30 for transplant samples. Is that possible?

ben (Facilities): @tom Lab fridge runs on building chilled loop unaffected by the water test, but we recommend scheduling time outside 09:30-11:30 to be safe. If you must at 10:30, Facilities will escort you and provide temporary cooler space. Fill the quick form: https://forms.company/lab-access.

rachel (People Ops): Volunteer logistics: the company will cover a $25 transit stipend for volunteers who travel to the community center + a $10 gratitude card for each volunteer who attends. Use expense code boston-vol-26.

maya: Confirming afternoon potluck 14:30-16:30 at HQ cafeteria. Will post RSVP.

ben (Facilities): Mailroom: any scheduled deliveries Fri AM will be accepted but large deliveries may be held until afternoon. If you expect a temperature-sensitive drop, mark it urgent and we'll coordinate a handoff at 13:30.

rachel (People Ops): Lactation/quiet room: temporary quiet room set up in Conference 3 for the morning (08:00-13:30) — if you need private time after 13:30, DM me and we'll reserve the usual room.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Boston - Water Pressure Test (logistics & potluck reschedule)" 2026-09-03. Location: Boston Office / Community Center fallback.

ben (Facilities): Facilities contact for the day: Ben K. (ext 307)  Slack or call 617-555-0191.

rachel (People Ops): Action items: Volunteers please RSVP by Thu EOD, food vendor confirmation by Wed EOD, and any lab/equipment flags post here. We'll send a final reminder Thu afternoon. Thanks! :thumbsup:
